comparison.objective: Place and snap-latch a case lid while bracing an unstable case; candidate commissions and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Align a lid in a pocket, stabilize the case bimanually, and press two spring latches, versus hex-bit insertion, bounded screw torque, collar rotation, and socket reacquisition.
comparison.success_condition: Both latches must click with lid centre within 3 mm and angle within 5 degrees, case motion constrained, and hands clear; candidate additionally requires two quantified physical stopping cycles.
comparison.reason: Shared alignment and locking are generic; snap-fit assembly under bracing tests a different mechanism and outcome from iterative damping adjustment.
